subject: MedSolutions: IAM evidence & SOC 2 next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Erin Shaw <erin@medsolutions.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: MedSolutions: IAM evidence & SOC 2 next steps

Hi Erin — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the items we discussed so the security team has a single checklist to work from.

Summary of what we covered:
- Redwood is able to support SSO via SAML 2.0 or OIDC. We also support SCIM v2 for user provisioning.
- We provide RBAC with distinct admin / audit / dev roles + configurable org-level policies.
- Audit logs are available via streaming export (Kafka/S3) and ad-hoc CSV exports.
- SOC 2 status: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in progress; expected completion Q4.
- Data residency & GDPR: customer-configurable region selection; we offer DPA and subprocessor list.
- HIPAA: we support BAA for covered use cases.

What we need from MedSolutions to continue the security qualification:
1) Current SOC 2 status / timeline or interim report (if available).
2) Any mandatory contractual language for HIPAA / BAA or data residency.
3) SSO details: are you planning SAML or OIDC? If SAML, please provide IdP metadata or sample metadata endpoint.
4) SCIM: provisioning requirements and attribute mapping (we'll share our default SCIM schema).
5) Admin role matrix: which MedSolutions roles should map to Redwood admin/dev/audit?
6) Preferred audit-log window for samples (90 days vs 365 days).

Attachments:
- redwood_iam_checklist.xlsx (IAM evidence checklist we use to intake customer asks)

Proposed timeline: If you can share items #1–#3 by EOD Tue (2027-09-14), Rafael and Monica can assemble the requested evidence and a sample export by Fri (2027-09-17).

Next step: Erin — can you confirm which SSO protocol you'll be using and share any SOC 2 artifacts you have now?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
[t] 415-555-0123 | tessa@redwood.com

From: Erin Shaw <erin@medsolutions.com>

Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 11:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MedSolutions: IAM evidence & SOC 2 next steps

Hi Tessa — appreciate the clear recap. A couple of quick answers and a file attached.

- SOC 2: We have our own SOC 2 Type II report (current through 2026) but we're comfortable sharing a high-level summary and the list of control owners. Our security team is putting together a timeline for a refreshed SOC 2 audit in Q4 2027. I've attached a short timeline doc.
- HIPAA/BAA: We will need BAA language; procurement will send our standard clause set once we see your standard BAA.
- SSO: We plan to use SAML 2.0 for initial rollout. I'll ask our IdP team for metadata and should be able to share by EOD Tue.
- SCIM: We'll want provisioning for users + groups. I'll include our attribute list if available.

Attachment: MedSolutions-SOC2-Timeline.pdf

I cc'd security@medsolutions.com so they see this thread. We'll aim to get items to you Tuesday as discussed.

Thanks — Erin
Erin Shaw
Senior IT Security Program Manager | MedSolutions Health
erin@medsolutions.com

Also include the standard BAA and DPA links so Erin can kick off procurement. I'm uploading our checklist and a draft DPA link here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c (shared read). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890.

Tessa — thanks for the heads up. We'll prepare the package and attach the following to this thread by end of day Friday:

1) saml_metadata.xml (SP metadata) — includes ACS URLs and cert thumbprint.
2) SCIM schema and examples (user and group payloads) — sample PUT/POST commands and example attribute mappings.
3) redwood_admin_matrix.csv — CSV mapping of common customer roles to Redwood role IDs.
4) audit_log_sample.csv — export covering the last 90 days (we can extend to 365 if they request; 365 requires DBA sign-off and extra exports).
5) SOC2_status_snapshot.pdf — brief one-pager describing current control coverage and expected Type II completion date.
6) Standard_BAA.docx and Redwood_DPA.pdf — procurement-ready docs.

Question: For the audit log sample, does MedSolutions prefer 90 days or 365 days for the initial sample? 90 days is quickest and avoids escalation. If Erin's security team asks for full 365-day history, we can accommodate but will need an org-level export (additional lead time).

I'll attach the files here once packaged. If you want, I can also do a short 20–30 minute walkthrough with Erin/security next week to walk through SAML metadata and SCIM mapping.

Rafael Mendes
